channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Invictus Theatre Postpones Latest Production To Investigate Abuse Allegations Against Director
item.description: The premiere of “Cat On A Hot Tin Roof” is on hold after at least four cast members resigned in response to abuse allegations about Artistic Director Charles Askenaizer.

item.title: 60 Years After MLK Visited Kenwood, Neighbors Say Their Power Comes From Community
item.description: Martin Luther King, Jr., spoke out against segregation and inequality in education at Kenwood United Church of Christ in 1966. Activists returned to the church on Tuesday to keep King's message alive.

item.title: Logan Square’s Open Books Closing After 3 Years
item.description: The bookstore closes March 1. The nonprofit's Pilsen and West Loop stores remain open.

item.title: How The Great Migration — And Segregation — Built The South Side’s Black-Owned Lounge Culture
item.description: For more than a century, cocktail lounges — distinct from dive bars and nightclubs — have served as essential gathering places for Black Chicagoans.

item.title: 21 Things To Do In Chicago This Weekend: Valentine’s Markets, Jazz Concerts And More
item.description: There's also a Lunar New Year celebration, a cumbia dance party, a Puppy Bowl party and Black History Month celebrations.

item.title: Indgó Mrktó Food Hall, Itz-Chel by Peke’s Bring More Dinner And Drink Options To Pilsen
item.description: The long-awaited food hall from chef Mer Mansuria is now serving dinner and drinks. Itz-Chel opens Thursday on 18th Street, specializing in Mayan cuisine.

item.title: Lincoln Park Salon Owner Crowned A ‘Neighborhood Champion’ For Giving Back
item.description: Edda Coscioni of Salon Edda is being recognized by the neighborhood chamber for her work fundraising for local nonprofits, building her eco-conscious business and coaching others.

item.title: Chicago Woman Shot By Border Patrol Plans To Attend Trump’s State Of The Union Address
item.description: Marimar Martinez is scheduled to attend Trump's address to Congress as a guest of Rep. Jesus "Chuy" Garcia, according to her attorney.

item.title: Palace Grill Up For Sale 2 Years After Fire Forced Its Closure
item.description: The Palace Grill property is being marketed as a redevelopment opportunity, signaling the end of the iconic 80-year-old restaurant near the United Center.

item.title: Teen Charged In Downtown Mass Shooting Was Also Shot Months Later, Prosecutors Say
item.description: Damaurion Cherry, 17, is being charged as an adult in the shooting that wounded seven teens outside the Chicago Theatre following the city's popular Christmas tree lighting ceremony.
